question: Do spirit arts users see the forms of spirits here and there, similar to how people in the real world with strong spiritual senses can receive impressions?
answer: Spirits basically don’t take on a real form as long as they’re not called, so I don’t think they’d be seen peeking out here and there. However, if a spirit arts user attempts to ‘feel’, ‘see’, or ‘hear’, they’re able to feel and see them, so if people with a strong spiritual sense can see ghosts when they try to see them, I think it’s probably the same sort of thing. There’s no such thing as ghosts, though.
